tool_args.rationale: The data rise and flatten through s_grad=2.44, while the recalled avalanche mechanism predicts a critical transition near 2.50–2.68 and explicitly recommends probing above 2.36. A high_sgrad_regime_probe is the least costly targeted observation to resolve this consequential ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Author the supercritical sink-gradient avalanche law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five initial samples are all below the cited critical region (s_grad ≤ 2.44), so they cannot identify or confirm the proposed threshold drop.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth Haldane or Cobb-Douglas model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed plateau at the largest gradient is consistent with competing saturation/threshold mechanisms; choosing among them without sampling above the hinted critical range risks poor forecast error.
Less targeted and more costly than the specifically recommended high-gradient measurement.
